name: Coding Theory
description: This course covers principles of information theory and error control coding for reliable communication. Topics include channel capacity, linear block codes, finite fields, Reed-Solomon and BCH codes, convolutional codes and Viterbi decoding, codes on graph, sum-product algorithm, turbo, LDPC codes, and polar codes, lattice and trellis-codes. Applications to wireless standards are emphasized.
